# Monster Math

> > Monster Math is an adaptive K-3 math learning app that builds elementary math fluency through personalized, game-based instruction aligned to Common Core standards.

Monster Math offers a comprehensive curriculum covering beginner math concepts through grade 3, with personalized child profiles and learning goals. The platform emphasizes math fact fluency through engaging lessons on addition, subtraction, multiplication strategies, and foundational number sense.

## Key Topics

- math fact fluency
- elementary math education
- personalized learning
- Common Core alignment
- beginner math concepts
- multiplication strategies
- addition and subtraction
- child profile setup
- K-3 curriculum
- repeated addition
- doubling strategy
- number line strategies
- adaptive learning
- math app comparisons

## Curriculum & Learning Path

- [Curriculum - Monster Math](https://www.monstermath.app/curriculum): K-3 math curriculum overview with Common Core aligned learning progression

## Math Lessons & Strategies

- [Adding 1 or 2 within 5](https://www.monstermath.app/add-1-or-2-within-5): Tutorial on adding 1 or 2 within 5 using visual number line strategies
- [Subtract 1 or 2 within 5](https://www.monstermath.app/subtract-1-or-2-within-5): Guide to subtracting 1 or 2 within 5 with concrete-to-abstract methods
- [Repeated Addition](https://www.monstermath.app/repeated-addition): Multiplication foundation lesson using repeated addition of equal groups
- [The Doubling Strategy](https://www.monstermath.app/doubling-strategy): Mental math technique for solving multiplication using doubling strategy
